Search rebuild work is complete and validated. Vector storage now bulk-upserts within one transaction, and migration 0042 adds the required unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index. The focused storage suite passes all 12 tests; the full service suite passes 247 tests with 4 skips.

Rebuild performance is substantially improved: 10,000 demo-tenant documents complete in a 2.41-second median and 2.88-second p95, versus 16.73 seconds previously. The implementation includes tenant-scoped invoice retrieval, bounded ordered concurrent embedding, 100-document request chunks, correct deletion/count behavior, and reuse of the management command’s embedding client. Focused rebuilder, index, and management tests pass, and current database indexes appear sufficient.

Remaining closeout: run Ruff and `git diff --check`, inspect the final status and diff, and verify the lint-suppression threshold wording changed from 20 to “more than 20.” A reproduced Ledgerly CSV export encoding test failure is a known pre-existing issue and intentionally remains unchanged. The recent operator messages were informal acknowledgements and contained no additional technical work. Payment-capture idempotency is the next major feature; cron/queue architecture, analytics streaming, tax snapshot documentation, recomputation estimates, and tenant-specific invoice numbering remain deferred.
